commit.message: fix(loop-closure): walking brief review-hardening — honest failure states

intent: Follow-up to the merged PR-C (#1158): fix every open reviewer finding from Codex, Devin, and Greptile on the walking brief. Tri-state gatherers (query failure is never rendered as calm emptiness), killswitch missing-branch variant recognized as disengaged, issue-lookup failure no longer creates duplicate unpinned issues, best-effort pin on bootstrap creation, markdown-escaped PR titles, date-keyed idempotent posting, and pending nightlies rendered pending instead of red.

negative_controls.command: python3 -c "import subprocess,sys; from pathlib import Path; p=Path('scripts/runtime/walking_brief.py'); orig=p.read_text(); mut=orig.replace('return data if isinstance(data, list) else None', 'return data if isinstance(data, list) else []'); assert mut!=orig; p.write_text(mut); r=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-m','pytest','tests/test_walking_brief.py','-q'],check=False); p.write_text(orig); sys.exit(0 if r.returncode!=0 else 2)"
negative_controls.name: collapsing-walkready-failure-to-empty-breaks-contract-test

honest_blockers: Pinning the bootstrap issue needs GraphQL pinIssue; if the token lacks the scope the run warns and proceeds unpinned (the issue body still asks the operator to pin).
Idempotent posting keys on a same-day marker lookup; if that lookup itself fails the brief posts anyway — one duplicate beats silence for the operator's only channel.
session_entry.rollback: Revert the single commit; the brief returns to the merged #1158 behavior. No runtime state is touched.
